personality_one_liner: A sleek, command-center interface that prioritizes live data, speed, and actionable insights over decorative noise.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary for clarity on dense data screens
dont's: Do not use blur on metrics or scanner rows to ensure max readability

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides a high-level view of portfolio value and daily P&L, answering 'what do I have and what is it worth?' at a glance.

states.error: Unable to load portfolio data + Retry button

screens.layout: Centered portfolio view using large condensed typography for total value. Modular cards for quick asset exposure and high-level P&L. Use subtle gradient overlays for depth. Avoid dense tables here; keep day-level volatility in secondary views. Background image with heavy scrim behind the main balance.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: A live, filterable feed of arbitrage opportunities across multiple DEXs.
screens.layout: Stacked list of cards. Each card displays the token pair, buy/sell DEX logos, spread %, and estimated profit. Use a 'dark-first utility' approach with sharp typography for numbers (spread, profit) and dividers instead of heavy card shadows. High-impact metrics dominate the visual hierarchy.

screens.name: OpportunityDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a specific arbitrage trade with route visualization and simulated execution.
screens.layout: Visual route representation showing the swap path. Custom forms for trade amount input using steppers or sliders. A large, sticky 'Execute Trade' primary CTA anchored at the bottom (thumb zone) inside a solid container. Includes gas estimation and slippage details clearly separated.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Log of past trades and realized P&L.
screens.layout: Simple, dense stacked list. Each row shows date, pair, route, and realized profit/loss in green/red. Uses a top segmented control to filter by timeframe or status.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: User preferences, profile, and app configuration.
screens.layout: Standard single-column stacked list of settings rows. Categories separated by clear headers. Tinted icon containers for each setting row.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Dark-First Utility as the sole personality. The UI must be highly functional, utilizing deep navy (#0B101E) base with bright Cyan/Lime accents, as requested by the user.
Implement Barlow Condensed for all metrics, numbers, and headers to emphasize high-impact data. Use IBM Plex Sans for highly readable body copy.
Skip glassmorphism entirely. Data density and contrast are paramount in a live crypto scanner. Use sharp borders and tonal separation instead of shadows.
Ensure every background image is darkened using a heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee foreground text legibility.
For the DEX logos (Uniswap, PancakeSwap, etc.), the Unsplash/Pexels fetch failed. Fall back to initials (e.g., 'UNI', 'PAN') inside a brandTertiary tinted circle.
The Opportunity Detail screen must feature a sticky 'Execute Trade' CTA at the bottom, anchored above the home indicator, regardless of scroll position.
Use success green (#10B981) for profit/gains and error red (#EF4444) for losses/spreads, ensuring these are only used meaningfully for status.
